'''Carbanti United Electronics''', also known as just '''Carbanti''', was a shipboard [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] systems manufacturer who worked closely with [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] and [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], they reverse-engineered their own products to create anti-detection and evasion packages, such as electromagnetic countermeasures. These new products were sold to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as well as [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] groups.
